message:
Prepare the update. Reply with {"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill. Do NOT create files: Ripple builds the .ics and .csv itself.
- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": the address of a single person (see the attached people.csv), otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants".
- The group grp_attendees grew. Do NOT message its existing members. Write one welcome message to the newcomers (group "grp_newcomers") and one to each supplier whose quantity changes.
- "actions": the recovery checklist for the organizer team, 3 to 8 items, most urgent first: {"title", "description", "owner" (a role or team named in the files, e.g. "Volunteer lead", "Organizer", "Caterer"), "deadline" (a time or day taken from the plan, never invented), "priority" ("high"|"medium"|"low")}. Include confirming every item of the chosen option's "to_confirm" list.
- "revised_schedule": every schedule item or commitment whose time or place changes: {"id": node id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "place": "..."}. Empty list if nothing moves.

messages.subject: Catering quantity update for 21 Nov lunch (200 to 230 attendees)
messages.body:
Dear Green Fork Catering team,

Due to late registrations, the number of attendees for the lunch delivery at 12:00 on 21 November at Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre has grown from 200 to 230. Please update the order quantity to 230 meals. The delivery time and location are unchanged.

Please confirm the revised dietary breakdown (the original order was 20 vegetarian, 8 vegan and 4 gluten-free) and the updated total, which we will reconcile against the contract's unit price of EUR 9.50.

Thank you,
The Organizer team

messages.subject: Welcome to the event – your registration is confirmed
messages.body:
Hello,

Welcome! Your registration for the event on 21 November at Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre has been confirmed. The schedule is unchanged: opening at 09:00, lunch at 12:00–13:00 and the awards at 16:30–17:00. We look forward to seeing you there.

The Organizer team

actions.description: Venue capacity is 500 per schedule.json, but the attendee group must be checked against the Grand Amphithéâtre layout and seating for the larger group.

actions.description: Add the 30 late registrations to the attendee list and review the attendee update before it is sent.

The skill points to a reference.md for the exact shape. Let me read it.

The user asked for a JSON shape with `messages`, `revised_schedule`, and `volunteer_tasks`, plus `actions`, and explicitly said not to create files. Key points I need to check:

- `chosen_scenario` is null, so there is no `to_confirm` list to draw from. I can't invent one; I'll note this in the actions.
- Revised schedule: the disruption is a resize of attendees; no schedule items or commitments move time or place (the venue is already the replaced_by name, and the catering delivery stays at 12:00 at the same location). So `revised_schedule` is empty.
- Suppliers whose quantity changes: the only commitment that resizes is `catering_delivery`, supplied by `grp_caterer` (Green Fork Catering). Send one message to them.
- Newcomers: 30 people to `grp_newcomers`, one welcome message to the group (no individual address is given, so use a description).
- Existing attendees are not messaged.
- Volunteer tasks: the people.csv has a volunteer lead (Greta Orchard) and volunteers, but no task is implied by the disruption beyond catering/registration. I'll keep it minimal and grounded, with an empty list if nothing is clearly required. Since the attendee count changes, a catering re-count is the only real task, owned by the Organizer.
- Deadlines: I can't invent times. The only times available are the 12:00 catering delivery and the 09:00 opening.

Message to the caterer: I must not invent a new total, price, or dietary breakdown for 230 people; the original diet counts are 20/8/4 for 200, so I'll state the quantity change to 230 and ask them to confirm the revised dietary split.
